_note: Rules for client-facing words (CLAUDE.md rules 6, 7, 16, 17 and locked-rules.md). The weekly review may add a rule here with Chris's approval. level: error (must fix) or warn (look again). kinds: which kinds of text the rule applies to (caption, client, pro, portal, print); missing = all.

rules.why: Client-facing words never credit AI, a system or automation (rule 16).
Only Chris's direct line goes in marketing and client messages; never the office line or anyone else's number.
No email addresses in posts, print or portal answers (Chris's address never in public; nobody else's contact details).
Sellers never get the buyer's, buyer's agent's or lender's contact details (locked rule 3).
Never give or confirm wiring details (locked rule 8). Escrow sends them to the buyer.

rules.pattern: \b(dream home|won'?t last|must see|nestled|boasts|turn[- ]key|priced to sell|act fast|hidden gem|oasis)\b

rules.why: No offer counts or price talk in posts unless Chris says so (copy brief).
A placeholder is still in the text.

rules.pattern: \b(perfect for (a )?famil(y|ies)|family[- ]friendly (neighborhood|community)|ideal for (young|a young|empty|retirees|singles|couples|professionals)|empty[- ]nesters?|young professionals|bachelor pad|adults? only|no (kids|children)|exclusive (neighborhood|community|area)|(safe|crime[- ]free) (neighborhood|area|community)|christian|near (the )?church|integrated neighborhood|ethnic|handicapped|able[- ]bodied|mature (persons?|adults?|couples?|individuals?)|adult (community|building|living|neighborhood)|singles only|no (wheelchairs|section 8)|physically fit|crippled|mentally ill|caucasian|oriental|hispanic (neighborhood|area|community|residence)|jewish (home|neighborhood|area)|catholic (home|neighborhood|area)|restricted (community|neighborhood|area)|perfect for (a )?(young )?(couples?|singles|retirees|empty[- ]nesters?|newlyweds))\b
rules.why: Fair Housing (HUD 24 CFR 100.75, the 1989 HUD word list, the 1995 HUD advertising memo; WA RCW 49.60.222): describe the property, never the people who should live there (brain.md §8, library/compliance.md).

require.why: Printed pieces carry the brokerage disclosure (rule 7).
